class.name: JarCelestialBody
class.brief_description: A planet, moon or star: the frame and gravity everything attached to it shares.
class.description: Put its [JarVoxelVolume] under it (or set [member volume]) and its layers ([JarBodyWater], [JarBodyAtmosphere], [JarBodyClouds]) and moons ([JarBodyOrbit]) under it. With a volume, the shape, center, up and sea level come from the volume's up field (radial or flat); without one (a distant moon), from [member shape], [member radius] and [member sea_level]. Gravity is [member surface_gravity] at the radius, falls off with the square of the distance outside and linearly to zero inside; on a flat body it is constant along the up axis. [JarVoxelUniverse] combines the bodies.

method.name: get_altitude
method.description: Height of [param global_position] above the sea level (from the center on round bodies, along the up axis on flat ones).

method.name: get_center
method.description: The center in global space (on a flat body: a point at height 0).

method.name: get_effective_radius
method.description: The radius gravity is measured from: [member radius], or the volume's sea level when 0.

method.name: get_effective_sea_level
method.description: The sea level (a radius on round bodies, a height on flat ones).

method.name: get_effective_rotating_frame_height
method.description: [member rotating_frame_height], or when 0: the top of the body's [JarBodyAtmosphere], else half its radius. Infinite on flat bodies.

method.name: get_gravity_at
method.description: This body's own pull at [param global_position].

method.name: get_sphere_of_influence
method.description: For a body on a [JarBodyOrbit]: the distance from its center within which it is the better frame of reference than the body it orbits, [code]orbit radius * (m / M)^0.4[/code], with masses from surface gravity and radius. [JarVoxelUniverse] makes it the anchor there, well before its gravity is stronger than the planet's. Infinite for bodies on no orbit.

method.name: get_terrain
method.description: The body's volume: [member volume], else the first [JarVoxelVolume] child.

members.member: No gravity beyond this distance from the center (faded over its last 10 percent). 0: unlimited.
Where gravity is [member surface_gravity]. 0: the volume's sea level.
Without a volume: the sea level above [member radius] (round) or the sea height (flat).

Below this height above sea level, while this body is the anchor, the scene turns with it: the ground stands still and the sky turns (see [JarVoxelUniverse]). Things moving along with the body (the demo player) do so below it as well. 0: the top of its atmosphere, else half its radius.
Without a volume: round or flat.
The axis the body spins about, in its parent's space.
Seconds per turn about [member spin_axis] (negative: the other way). 0: no spin.
Gravity at the radius, in m/s2.
The body's terrain. Empty: the first [JarVoxelVolume] child, if any.

constants.constant: A flat body (up is +Y of the node).
